name: faebloom_trick_taps_an_opponents_creature
notes: Printed: 'Create two 1/1 blue Faerie creature tokens with flying. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls.' Seat 0 casts Faebloom Trick (no target as it is cast); it makes two Faeries, and the reflexive trigger then targets seat 1's 3/3 Ogre (chosen as the trigger goes on the stack) and taps it. Seat 0's own 2/2 is not a legal target and stays untapped.
